sentences.zh: 2011年，在一处加利福尼亚州的葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被抽干了。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来她的凶手费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字，艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份只会让这起离奇的谋杀案更加令人迷惑。

sentences.en: The village of Horton is nestled on the edge of the rolling hillsides and grassy meadows that define the Cotswolds in southwest England.
sentences.zh: 霍顿村坐落在起伏的山坡和草地边缘，这些草地定义了英格兰西南部的科茨沃尔德。

sentences.en: In 1984, Horton was home to about 250 residents.
sentences.zh: 1984年，霍顿大约有250名居民。

sentences.en: Most of them were farming families like the Backhouses, the owner-operators of a dairy farm called Whidden Hill.
sentences.zh: 他们大多数是像巴克豪斯家族这样的耕作家庭，经营着一家名为惠登山的乳牛场。

sentences.en: 43-year-old patriarch Graham Backhouse lived at the property with his wife and two young children.
sentences.zh: 43岁的家族家长格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯与妻子和两个年幼的孩子住在该物业里。

sentences.en: He worked on the farm full-time with the assistance of several farmhands and herdsmen.
sentences.zh: 他在农场全职工作，有几名农场工人和牧牛人的协助。

sentences.en: At 300 acres, Whittenhill Farm was a decent size for a non-industrial operation.
sentences.zh: 威滕希尔农场占地300英亩，对于一个非工业化运营的农场来说，规模相当不错。

sentences.en: To walk the entirety of the farm's perimeter took at least 45 minutes.
sentences.zh: 步行完农场的整个周长至少需要45分钟。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, April 3, 1984, one of the farmhands was conducting an inspection of Wittenhill's fence line when he came across a disturbing sight.
sentences.zh: 1984年4月3日星期二，一名农场工人正在检查威滕希尔的栅栏时，偶然看到了一幕令人不安的景象。

sentences.en: Impaled on a fence post was a freshly decapitated sheep's head.
sentences.zh: 一根栅栏柱上插着一颗刚被砍下的羊头。

sentences.en: Pinned beneath it was a handwritten note containing two words.
sentences.zh: 压在它下面的是一张写着两个字的手写便条。

sentences.en: You next.
sentences.zh: 下一个就是你。

sentences.en: When Wittenhill's owner, Graham Backhouse, was informed about the gruesome discovery, he immediately knew that the message was directed at him.
sentences.zh: 当威滕希尔的所有者格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯被告知这一可怕的发现时，他立刻知道这条信息是冲着他来的。

sentences.en: Over the last few weeks, someone had made it clear they had a vendetta against Graham.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几周里，有人明确表示他们对格雷厄姆怀恨在心。

sentences.en: It started in mid-March.
sentences.zh: 这一切始于3月中旬。

sentences.en: Graham was sorting through the farm's mail when a handwritten letter caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆正在整理农场的信件时，一封手写信引起了他的注意。

sentences.en: It was addressed to Graham specifically and read,
sentences.zh: 信是专门写给格雷厄姆的，上面写着：

sentences.en: At last I have found you.
sentences.zh: 我终于找到你了。

sentences.en: You have ruined my sister's life.
sentences.zh: 你毁了我姐姐的生活。

sentences.en: Now you must pay.
sentences.zh: 现在你必须付出代价。

sentences.en: The sender didn't elaborate any further, nor did they reveal their identity.
sentences.zh: 寄信人没有做进一步的详细说明，也没有透露他们的身份。

sentences.en: Graham wasn't overly concerned about the letter as he had no idea what it could be alluding to.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆并不是很担心这封信，因为他不知道这可能在暗示什么。

sentences.en: He threw it in the bin.
sentences.zh: 他把它扔进了垃圾桶。

sentences.en: Days later, the farmhouse phone rang.
sentences.zh: 几天后，农舍的电话响了。

sentences.en: Graham answered the call.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆接了电话。

sentences.en: On the other line was a man whose voice he didn't recognise.
sentences.zh: 电话那头是一个他听不出声音的男人。

sentences.en: It sounded like he was using a fake Irish or Scottish accent.
sentences.zh: 听起来他是在用伪造的爱尔兰或苏格兰口音。

sentences.en: The caller threatened to blow Graham's balls off before hanging up.
sentences.zh: 打电话的人威胁要轰掉格雷厄姆的蛋蛋，然后挂断了电话。

sentences.en: The following week, Graham received another mysterious phone call.
sentences.zh: 第二周，格雷厄姆又接到了一个神秘的电话。

sentences.en: As soon as he heard the male voice, he could tell it was the same anonymous caller.
sentences.zh: 一听到这个男人的声音，他就能看出这就是那个匿名来电者。

sentences.en: This time, the man threatened Graham's family, referring to his wife, 37-year-old Margaret, and their children, 8-year-old Harry and 6-year-old Sophie, by name.
sentences.zh: 这一次，这名男子威胁了格雷厄姆的家人，指名道姓地提到了他的妻子、37岁的玛格丽特，以及他们的孩子、8岁的哈利和6岁的苏菲。

sentences.en: Graham told Margaret about the letter and phone calls, but otherwise kept the harassment to himself.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆把信和电话的事告诉了玛格丽特，但除此之外，他把这些骚扰藏在心里。

sentences.en: After the discovery of the slaughtered sheep and the explicit death threat left on their fence in April,
sentences.zh: 在4月份发现被宰杀的羊和留在他们栅栏上的明确死亡威胁之后，

sentences.en: Graham could no longer dismiss the danger.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆再也不能无视这种危险了。

sentences.en: He contacted the police.
sentences.zh: 他联系了警察。

sentences.en: When officers arrived at Whitten Hill, neither Graham nor Margaret could offer any explanation as to why they had been targeted.
sentences.zh: 当警察到达惠登山时，格雷厄姆和玛格丽特都无法解释他们为什么会成为目标。

sentences.en: With no immediate leads, police connected a recording device to the farm's phone line.
sentences.zh: 由于没有直接线索，警方在农场的电话线上连接了一个录音设备。

sentences.en: Should the mystery man call again, police would at least have a recording of his threats.
sentences.zh: 如果神秘男子再次来电，警方至少能录下他的威胁。

sentences.en: In the meantime, investigators searched for anyone who might hold a grudge against Graham Backhouse.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，调查人员寻找任何可能对格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯怀恨在心的人。

sentences.en: They discovered he had a blemish to his name.
sentences.zh: 他们发现他的名誉上有污点。

sentences.en: Just over ten years earlier, Graham and his father, Bill Backhouse, were convicted of stealing three young cows belonging to a neighbouring farmer.
sentences.zh: 就在十年前，格雷厄姆和他的父亲比尔·巴克豪斯因偷窃邻近农民的三头小牛而被定罪。

sentences.en: The judge described the theft as disgraceful and dishonourable.
sentences.zh: 法官形容这起偷窃行为是耻辱和不光彩的。

sentences.en: The Backhouse men were each fined £600, the equivalent of roughly £10,000 in today's money.
sentences.zh: 巴克豪斯父子分别被罚款600英镑，相当于今天大约10,000英镑的价值。

sentences.en: However, police quickly dismissed the disgruntled farmer as a potential suspect in the recent harassment.
sentences.zh: 然而，警方很快排除了这位心怀不满的农民作为近期骚扰案的潜在嫌疑人。

sentences.en: He passed away in 1977.
sentences.zh: 他在1977年去世了。

sentences.en: After Graham's conviction for theft, he spent the next decade rebuilding his reputation in Horton.
sentences.zh: 在格雷厄姆因盗窃罪被定罪后，他在接下来的十年里重建了自己在霍顿的名誉。

sentences.en: Police inquiries revealed that the backhouses were considered a typical, happy farming family who were well-respected around town.
sentences.zh: 警方的调查显示，巴克豪斯一家被认为是典型、幸福的农场家庭，在镇上备受尊敬。

sentences.en: Six days after the discovery of the sheep's head, on the morning of Monday April 9, Graham walked to the farm's mailbox.
sentences.zh: 在发现羊头六天后，即4月9日星期一上午，格雷厄姆走向农场的信箱。

sentences.en: Inside was a handwritten envelope addressed only to Backhouse.
sentences.zh: 里面有一个手写信封，收件人只写着“巴克豪斯”。

sentences.en: Graham immediately recognised the distinctive handwriting.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆一眼就认出了这独特的笔迹。

sentences.en: Inside was a letter that read,
sentences.zh: 里面有一封信，上面写着：

sentences.en: Came twice last week, but the pigs were about.
sentences.zh: 上周来过两次，但有猪在附近晃悠。

sentences.en: There was no name or signature at the bottom, only the words, See you soon.
sentences.zh: 底部没有名字或签名，只有“回头见”几个字。

sentences.en: Later that morning, Margaret Backhouse needed to drive into town to pick up supplies from the vet.
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，玛格丽特·巴克豪斯需要开车进城去兽医那里取点物资。

sentences.en: Graham reminded Margaret that her Fiat was playing up so she should take his Volvo instead.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆提醒玛格丽特，她的菲亚特汽车有点毛病，所以她应该开他的沃尔沃去。

sentences.en: Margaret entered the barn next to the farmhouse where her husband kept his vehicle.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特走进了农舍旁边的谷仓，她丈夫的车就停在那里。

sentences.en: She got into the driver's seat and turned the key in the ignition.
sentences.zh: 她坐上驾驶座，把钥匙插进点火开关并转动。

sentences.en: A great force of energy exploded from underneath the vehicle, tearing a hole through the floor and ripping the driver's seat in half.
sentences.zh: 一股巨大的能量从车底爆炸开来，在车底板上炸出一个洞，把驾驶座撕成了两半。

sentences.en: There was blood everywhere.
sentences.zh: 到处都是血。

sentences.en: The tissue on Margaret's thighs and buttocks had been blown to shreds.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特大腿和臀部的肌肉组织已经被炸成了碎片。

sentences.en: She opened the car door and fell onto the ground, managing to crawl her way out of the barn.
sentences.zh: 她打开车门摔倒在地上，勉强爬出了谷仓。

sentences.en: Michael cleverly was driving the local school bus past Woodenhill Farm when he noticed Margaret Backhouse lying on the driveway, desperately waving one hand in the air.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔当时正巧开着当地的校车经过伍登希尔农场，他注意到玛格丽特·巴克豪斯躺在车道上，绝望地单手在空中挥舞。

sentences.en: Michael stopped his bus and dashed to Margaret's side.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔停下车，冲到玛格丽特身边。

sentences.en: Schoolgirl Susan Wilkie also jumped off the bus.
sentences.zh: 女学生苏珊·威尔基也跳下了车。

sentences.en: Susan lived on a nearby farm and knew the back houses.
sentences.zh: 苏珊住在附近的一个农场，认识巴克豪斯一家。

sentences.en: She ran through Widden Hill, shouting, Graham, Margaret's had an accident.
sentences.zh: 她穿过威登希尔，大喊道：“格雷厄姆，玛格丽特出事故了。”

sentences.en: Graham emerged from the milking shed out of earshot of the blaSt. When he saw Margaret's injuries, he turned pale and began shaking.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆从挤奶棚里出来，爆炸声传不到他那里。当他看到玛格丽特的伤势时，脸色变得煞白，浑身发抖。

sentences.en: He ran into the farmhouse and called an ambulance, before re-emerging with a blanket that he lay over Margaret.
sentences.zh: 他跑进农舍叫了救护车，然后拿了一条毯子出来盖在玛格丽特身上。

sentences.en: Through pain and shock, Margaret told Graham not to move or touch her.
sentences.zh: 强忍着痛苦和休克，玛格丽特告诉格雷厄姆不要搬动或触摸她。

sentences.en: Margaret was taken to hospital with severe injuries to her buttocks, thigh, and lower back.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特被送往医院，臀部、大腿和下背部严重受伤。

sentences.en: Surgeons spent seven hours removing deeply embedded shrapnel and did their best to salvage the remaining tissue.
sentences.zh: 外科医生花了七个小时取出深陷的弹片，并尽最大努力挽救剩下的组织。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, police sealed off Whittenhill.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，警方封锁了惠滕希尔。

sentences.en: An army bomb disposal unit was called in to clear the scene.
sentences.zh: 军方拆弹小组被召集来清理现场。

sentences.en: Once it was deemed safe, police explosive experts processed the wreckage of the Volvo.
sentences.zh: 在确认安全后，警方爆炸物专家对沃尔沃的残骸进行了勘察。

sentences.en: Little evidence of the explosion was visible from the car's exterior.
sentences.zh: 从车身外观来看，几乎看不到爆炸的痕迹。

sentences.en: Only the roof was slightly dented and a window pane cracked.
sentences.zh: 只有车顶微微凹陷，一块窗玻璃碎裂。

sentences.en: However, when police opened the doors, there was practically nothing left of the driver's side floor or seat.
sentences.zh: 然而，当警察打开车门时，驾驶座一侧的地板和座椅几乎荡然无存。

sentences.en: Specialists determined that a homemade pipe bomb had been placed under the car, beneath the driver's seat.
sentences.zh: 专家确定，一枚自制管状炸弹被放置在汽车底部、驾驶座下方。

sentences.en: The bomb was made using a 10cm long piece of steel scuffolding pipe which had been screwed onto a cast iron collar.
sentences.zh: 这枚炸弹是用一节10厘米长的钢制脚手架管制作的，管子拧在了一个铸铁套领上。

sentences.en: The pipe had been packed with 4,500 lead pellets and gunpowder from up to 12 shotgun cartridges.
sentences.zh: 管子里塞满了4500粒铅弹和多达12个猎枪弹壳里的火药。

sentences.en: Margaret Backhouse wouldn't have noticed anything out of the ordinary.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·巴克豪斯本不会注意到任何异常。

sentences.en: The bomb had been wired to the ignition and the fuse of a heating element that warmed up the driver's seat, with the wiring concealed from view.
sentences.zh: 炸弹与点火开关以及加热驾驶座的发热元件的保险丝相连，电线隐藏得很好，肉眼无法看到。

sentences.en: As soon as Margaret turned to the Volvo's ignition, the bomb exploded.
sentences.zh: 就在玛格丽特转动沃尔沃点火开关的那一刻，炸弹爆炸了。

sentences.en: In any other car, the explosion would have likely been fatal.
sentences.zh: 换作任何其他汽车，这场爆炸很可能是致命的。

sentences.en: However, the Backhouser's Volvo was a particular model that had thinner, more flexible floor panels and a solid, heavy seat that was bolted to the frame.
sentences.zh: 然而，巴克豪斯家的沃尔沃是一款特殊的车型，它的底盘更薄、更有弹性，并且有一个用螺栓固定在车架上的坚固重型座椅。

sentences.en: The floor panels absorbed the vast majority of the bomb's impact and the seat's sturdy construction acted like a safety cage.
sentences.zh: 底盘吸收了绝大部分爆炸冲击力，座椅坚固的结构则起到了安全笼的作用。

sentences.en: These features had saved Margaret's life.
sentences.zh: 正是这些特点救了玛格丽特的命。

sentences.en: One detective described the bomb to the Bristol Evening Post as a diabolical device placed by someone who has no consideration for human life.
sentences.zh: 一名侦探向《布里斯托晚报》形容这枚炸弹是一个“恶魔般的装置，由一个完全不顾及人命的人放置”。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案发现场》稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.zh: 这条信息献给所有对烧烤极其认真的人。

sentences.en: Yes, I'm talking to 99.9% of all Aussies.
sentences.zh: 是的，我说的就是99.9%的澳大利亚人。

sentences.en: Apologies to the 0.1% of you who might find this a bit boring.
sentences.zh: 向觉得这可能有点无聊的0.1%的人道歉。

sentences.en: But if you want to take your barbecuing to the next level, you need to know about outdoor grilling equipment from Made In,
sentences.zh: 但如果你想把你的烧烤水平提升到一个新的高度，你需要了解来自Made In的户外烧烤设备，

sentences.en: the company that supplies many of the world's most famous chefs.

sentences.en: Their carbon steel griddle, for example, is a professional-grade griddle that turns an ordinary barbecue into a large, restaurant-style flat top.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们的碳钢煎盘是一款专业级煎盘，能把普通的烧烤变成一个大型的、餐厅风格的平面铁板烧。

sentences.en: It's perfect for snags, steaks, veggies, fish, and breakfast foods like pancakes and eggs and bacon.
sentences.zh: 它非常适合烤香肠、牛排、蔬菜、鱼，以及早餐食物，比如煎饼、鸡蛋和培根。

sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: Margaret Backhouse was a fundraiser and local treasurer for the Save the Children charity.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·巴克豪斯是“拯救儿童”慈善机构的筹款人和当地财务主管。

sentences.en: It seemed highly unlikely that she'd run afoul of anyone in town.
sentences.zh: 她似乎不太可能在镇上得罪任何人。

sentences.en: Given that Graham Backhouse was the one who usually drove the Volvo, police believed that he had been the intended target of the car bomb.
sentences.zh: 鉴于格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯通常是开沃尔沃的人，警方认为他才是汽车炸弹的真正目标。

sentences.en: Fearing for their safety, Graham and Margaret's children were sent to stay with their grandmother.
sentences.zh: 出于对自身安全的担忧，格雷厄姆和玛格丽特的的孩子们被送去和祖母同住。

sentences.en: Graham returned to Whidden Hill, with a 24-hour police presence established to guard against any further attacks.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆回到了威登希尔，警方安排了24小时警力驻守，以防范任何进一步的袭击。

sentences.en: While Margaret recovered in hospital, Graham attended the police station for an interview.
sentences.zh: 在玛格丽特于医院康复期间，格雷厄姆前往警察局接受了问询。

sentences.en: With the harasser delivering on their threats, Graham knew it was time to talk.
sentences.zh: 随着骚扰者将威胁付诸行动，格雷厄姆知道是时候开口了。

sentences.en: Contrary to what he'd previously told detectives, Graham conceded there could be someone in the village who held a grudge against him.
sentences.zh: 与他先前对侦探所说的话相反，格雷厄姆承认村里可能有人对心存怨恨。

sentences.en: He admitted he was having a boundary dispute with one of his neighbours.
sentences.zh: 他承认自己正与其中一位邻居发生边界纠纷。

sentences.en: Detectives noted this information but deemed it an unlikely motive.
sentences.zh: 侦探们记下了这条信息，但认为这不太可能是作案动机。

sentences.en: It was much more likely that the person responsible for the harassment and bomb held a more personal grievance against Graham.
sentences.zh: 更有可能是制造骚扰和炸弹的那个人对格雷厄姆怀有更私人的怨恨。

sentences.en: With a little further prodding, Graham made another confession.
sentences.zh: 在进一步的追问下，格雷厄姆作出了另一项供认。

sentences.en: During the 12 years he'd been married to Margaret, he'd had multiple affairs.
sentences.zh: 在与玛格丽特结婚的12年里，他有过多次外遇。

sentences.en: In the months leading up to the car bomb, he'd had a drunken sexual encounter with a woman named Caroline Hodkinson.
sentences.zh: 在汽车炸弹事件发生前的几个月里，他曾与一个名叫卡罗琳·霍奇金森的女人有过一次酒后性行为。

sentences.en: Caroline was the wife of Graham's good friend, David, who'd been the best man at Graham and Margaret's wedding.
sentences.zh: 卡罗琳是格雷厄姆的好朋友大卫的妻子，大卫曾担任格雷厄姆和玛格丽特婚礼上的伴郎。

sentences.en: Graham admitted he'd also been having occasional sex with a 24-year-old shepherdess named Jillian
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆承认，他还和一个24岁的女牧羊人吉莉安有过偶尔的性关系

sentences.en: Lippiat.
sentences.zh: 利皮亚特。

sentences.en: Jillian lived on her family's farm on the edge of Horton, which overlooked Whitten Hill.
sentences.zh: 吉莉安住在霍顿边缘她家族的农场里，那里可以俯瞰惠滕希尔。

sentences.en: According to Graham, the two had been casually sleeping together for the past nine years.
sentences.zh: 据格雷厄姆称，两人在过去的九年里一直保持着随意的性伴侣关系。

sentences.en: Graham denied having romantic feelings towards Jillian, but said he was flattered by the attention from someone half his age.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆否认自己对吉莉安动过真情，但表示虚荣心得到了满足，毕竟对方只有他一半大。

sentences.en: Graham Backhouse's infidelity confession didn't come as a complete surprise to police.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯的不忠供词并没有完全出乎警察的意料。

sentences.en: Horton was a small place.
sentences.zh: 霍顿是个小地方。

sentences.en: Rumours had already been circulating around town, with one local telling the Sunday Times, We all know each other very well.
sentences.zh: 镇上已经流言四起，一位当地人告诉《星期日泰晤士报》：“我们彼此非常熟悉。”

sentences.en: Some of us too well.
sentences.zh: “我们有些人甚至太熟了。”

sentences.en: A lover's revenge quickly rose to the top of the list for potential motives.
sentences.zh: 情人的复仇迅速上升为潜在动机名单的首位。

sentences.en: Detectives considered whether Jillian Lipiat could be behind the bomb and harassment.
sentences.zh: 侦探们开始调查吉莉安·利皮亚特是否是炸弹和骚扰事件的幕后黑手。

sentences.en: Or maybe someone in the Lippiat family was upset about Graham's sexual interest in Gillian.
sentences.zh: 或者也有可能是利皮亚特家族的某个人对格雷厄姆和吉莉安之间的性趣感到不满。

sentences.en: Her father was one of the best and most accomplished cereal growers in the business and a popular personality in Horton.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲是业内最优秀、最有成就的谷物种植者之一，也是霍顿备受欢迎的人物。

sentences.en: He and his family had been close friends with the backhouses for more than a decade.
sentences.zh: 他和他的家人与巴克豪斯家族有着十多年的密切友谊。

sentences.en: When questioned by police, the members of the Lippiat family all denied responsibility for the car bomb.
sentences.zh: 当被警方盘问时，利皮亚特家族的成员都否认制造了汽车炸弹。

sentences.en: As for the suggestion that she was having a sexual relationship with Graham Backhouse, Gillian said it was a complete figment of
sentences.zh: 至于她与格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯有染的说法，吉莉安表示这完全是

sentences.en: Graham's imagination.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆的想象。

sentences.en: She called it extremely distasteful and denied any such contact, saying her interactions with Graham over the years had been very limited.
sentences.zh: 她称这种说法极其令人反感，并否认有任何此类接触，称她多年来与格雷厄姆的互动非常有限。

sentences.en: He occasionally helped her shear sheep or euthanise her injured animals, but nothing sexual had ever occurred between them.
sentences.zh: 他偶尔帮她剪羊毛或安乐死受伤的动物，但他们之间从未发生过任何性接触。

sentences.en: Unsure what to make of this, police turned their attention to the other woman Graham had admitted to being intimate with, Caroline Hodkinson.
sentences.zh: 警察对这一点感到困惑，于是将注意力转向了格雷厄姆承认与之有过亲密关系的另一名女子卡罗琳·霍奇金森。

sentences.en: They discovered that Caroline's husband, David, was an electrical engineer who had previously worked with explosives.
sentences.zh: 他们发现卡罗琳的丈夫大卫是一名电气工程师，以前曾从事过炸药工作。

sentences.en: He'd also conducted repairs on Graham's Volvo in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 过去他还在格雷厄姆的沃尔沃汽车上进行过修理。

sentences.en: Police arrived at the
sentences.zh: 警察来到了

sentences.en: Hodkinson house to question the couple only to find that David was in Spain and had been there since before the explosion
sentences.zh: 霍奇金森家盘问这对夫妇，却发现大卫在西班牙，而且在爆炸发生前就已经在那里了。

sentences.en: However, David's absence from the area on the day of the bomb didn't necessarily rule him out as a suspect As soon as he returned home he was promptly placed under arrest
sentences.zh: 然而，大卫在爆炸当天不在该地区并不一定能排除他是嫌疑人的嫌疑。他一回到家，就立即被拘留。

sentences.en: David Hodkinson was held for questioning for two days but police couldn't find any evidence to connect him to the bomb and they had no choice but to release him.
sentences.zh: 大卫·霍奇金森被拘留审讯两天，但警方找不到任何证据将他与炸弹联系起来，别无选择，只能释放他。

sentences.en: Nine days after the explosion, Graham Backhouse insisted he no longer wanted the 24-hour police presence at the farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 爆炸发生九天后，格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯坚称他不再希望农舍里有24小时的警察。

sentences.en: He wanted the bomber to, quote, have another go while Margaret was still in hospital and the kids were safely staying elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 他希望轰炸机，引述说，在玛格丽特还在医院而孩子在其他地方安全呆着的时候，再试一次。

sentences.en: It seemed to be the only way to identify the person responsible, and Graham believed the bomber was unlikely to strike while the police were there.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是确定责任人的唯一途径，格雷厄姆认为轰炸机不太可能在警察在场的情况下罢工。

sentences.en: Investigators reluctantly agreed, but as a precaution, they installed a button onto the farmhouse phone providing a direct connection to the police.
sentences.zh: 调查人员勉强同意了，但作为预防措施，他们在农舍电话上安装了一个按钮，可以直接连接到警察局。

sentences.en: Weeks passed without incident.
sentences.zh: 数周过去了，没有发生任何事件。

sentences.en: Having reached a dead end with the lover's revenge theory, police looked into the land dispute Graham Backhouse claimed to be having with his neighbour, Colin Bedale-Taylor.
sentences.zh: 在情人复仇论走投无路后，警方调查了格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯声称与邻居科林·贝代尔-泰勒发生的土地纠纷。

sentences.en: The 63-year-old former army officer lived in a converted cottage known as The Gatehouse.
sentences.zh: 这位63岁的前陆军军官住在一座被称为“门房”的改建小屋里。

sentences.en: The cottage's driveway ran alongside the back fields of Woodin Hill Farm.
sentences.zh: 小屋的车道沿着乌丁希尔农场的后田运行。

sentences.en: According to Graham,
sentences.zh: 据格雷厄姆说，

sentences.en: Colin had been denying him his legal right to use the driveway so that he could access the fields.
sentences.zh: 科林一直剥夺他使用车道的合法权利，以便他能进入田野。

sentences.en: On Monday, April 30, three weeks after the bombing, detectives visited the home of
sentences.zh: 4月30日星期一，也就是爆炸发生三周后，侦探们访问了

sentences.en: Columba Dale Taylor and his wife, also named Margaret.
sentences.zh: 哥伦巴·戴尔·泰勒和他的妻子，也叫玛格丽特。

sentences.en: The couple had lived in the gatehouse for over 20 years where they raised their four children.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇在门房住了20多年，抚养了四个孩子。

sentences.en: When questioned about the boundary dispute, Colin denied having any conflict with Graham or anyone else involved with Whittenhill.
sentences.zh: 当被问及边界争端时，科林否认与格雷厄姆或任何其他与惠滕希尔有关的人发生过冲突。

sentences.en: He claimed he and Margaret barely knew the backhouses
sentences.zh: 他声称他和玛格丽特几乎不认识巴克豪斯

sentences.en: Colin was later excused so that the detectives could speak candidly with his wife
sentences.zh: 科林后来被原谅了，以便侦探可以与他的妻子坦诚交谈

sentences.en: They then asked her about Colin's criminal convictions
sentences.zh: 然后他们问她关于科林的刑事定罪情况

sentences.en: Margaret was blindsided She had no idea what the detectives were talking about
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特被打了个措手不及。她不知道侦探们在说什么

sentences.en: They explained that Colin had been convicted twice for shoplifting
sentences.zh: 他们解释说，科林曾因入店行窃被定罪两次

sentences.en: After recovering from her shock, Margaret explained that the last few years had been very difficult, especially for Colin.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特从震惊中恢复过来后解释说，过去几年非常艰难，尤其是对科林来说。

sentences.en: In 1981, Colin lost his job and fell into depression.
sentences.zh: 1981年，科林失业并陷入抑郁。

sentences.en: The following year, Colin and Margaret's youngest son, 19-year-old Digby, was killed in a car accident.
sentences.zh: 第二年，科林和玛格丽特最小的儿子，19岁的迪格比，在车祸中丧生。

sentences.en: The driver of the car was Digby's friend, Denzel Woolicott.
sentences.zh: 汽车的司机是迪格比的朋友丹泽尔·伍利科特。

sentences.en: Denzel survived the crash and was charged with reckless driving, but later cleared of any criminal liability.
sentences.zh: 丹泽尔在车祸中幸存下来，并被指控鲁莽驾驶，但后来被免除了刑事责任。

sentences.en: He was eventually employed by Graham Backhouse to do odd jobs at Whidden Hill.
sentences.zh: 他最终被格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯雇用在惠登希尔做杂工。

sentences.en: Colin's mental health suffered further each time he crossed paths with Denzel.
sentences.zh: 每当科林与丹泽尔擦肩而过，他的心理健康就会受到进一步的损害。

sentences.en: Despite these hardships, Margaret assured the detectives that Colin had just started seeing a psychiatrist and was getting the help he needed.
sentences.zh: 尽管有这些困难，玛格丽特向侦探保证，科林刚开始看精神科医生，并得到了他需要的帮助。

sentences.en: During this discussion,
sentences.zh: 在这次讨论中，

sentences.en: Colin busied himself in his workshop.
sentences.zh: 科林在车间里忙碌。

sentences.en: As a way to pass time, he had taken to restoring old furniture for people in the village.
sentences.zh: 为了打发时间，他开始为村里的人修复旧家具。

sentences.en: Eventually, Colin put his tools down and popped his head inside the house.
sentences.zh: 最终，科林放下工具，把头探进屋里。

sentences.en: Margaret was still speaking with the detectives.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特仍在与侦探交谈。

sentences.en: Colin interrupted briefly to tell his wife that he was going to the backhouses, but offered no explanation as to why.
sentences.zh: 科林短暂地打断了一下，告诉他的妻子他要去巴克豪斯家，但没有解释原因。

sentences.en: Neither she nor the detectives questioned it.
sentences.zh: 她和侦探都没有质疑。

sentences.en: It was around sunset as Colin Bedale-Taylor walked the short distance to Whitton Hill Farm.
sentences.zh: 日落时分，科林·贝代尔-泰勒步行一小段路来到惠顿希尔农场。

sentences.en: Outside, the place was quiet.
sentences.zh: 外面，这个地方很安静。

sentences.en: The workers had left for the day and there were no longer any police guarding the property.
sentences.zh: 工人们已经下班了，也没有警察守卫这个地方。

sentences.en: Lights were on inside the farmhouse as Colin knocked on the front door.
sentences.zh: 当科林敲前门时，农舍里面的灯亮着。

sentences.en: Ten minutes later, the sound of sirens pierced the air.
sentences.zh: 十分钟后，警笛声刺破了空气。

sentences.en: Eight police cars and an ambulance sped up Horton Hill.
sentences.zh: 八辆警车和一辆救护车驶向霍顿山。

sentences.en: Someone had raised the panic alarm at Whidden Hill.
sentences.zh: 有人在惠登希尔按下了恐慌警报。

sentences.en: Officers entered the farmhouse to a confronting sight.
sentences.zh: 警察进入农舍，看到了一个面对面的景象。

sentences.en: Graham Backhouse was standing in the hallway dripping with blood.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯站在走廊里，血流如注。

sentences.en: The left side of his face had been slashed from ear to lip.
sentences.zh: 他脸的左侧从耳朵到嘴唇被割开。

sentences.en: A long, deep wound ran from his left shoulder across to his right hip.
sentences.zh: 一道长而深的伤口从他的左肩一直延伸到右臀。

sentences.en: Beside him was a 12-gauge shotgun.
sentences.zh: 在他旁边是一支12口径猎枪。

sentences.en: Colin Bedale Taylor laid dead on the hallway floor.
sentences.zh: 科林·贝代尔·泰勒死在走廊地板上。

sentences.en: He had taken two shotgun blasts to the cheSt. In his right hand was a Stanley knife.
sentences.zh: 他的胸部中了两枪。右手拿着一把史丹利刀。

sentences.en: Graham was swiftly taken to hospital where he underwent surgery to close his wounds.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆被迅速送往医院接受手术缝合伤口。

sentences.en: The injury to his face alone required
sentences.zh: 仅面部受伤就需要

sentences.en: 50 stitches.
Police kept a guard over both his room and Margaret's while the Backhouse's children fled Horton with their grandparents to ensure their safety.
sentences.zh: 警方派人看守他和玛格丽特的房间，而巴克豪斯的孩子们则与祖父母一起逃离霍顿，以确保他们的安全。

sentences.en: When Graham was able to speak, police interviewed him at his bedside.
sentences.zh: 当格雷厄姆能够说话时，警方在床边采访了他。

sentences.en: He told them that Colin Bedale-Taylor had knocked on the farmhouse door.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，科林·贝代尔-泰勒敲了农舍的门。

sentences.en: Graham invited him inside and the two sat down at the kitchen table.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆邀请他进去，两人在厨房桌子旁坐下。

sentences.en: At first, Colin inquired about Margaret's recovery, then asked whether Graham had any old furniture that needed repair.
sentences.zh: 起初，科林询问玛格丽特的康复情况，然后询问格雷厄姆是否有需要修理的旧家具。

sentences.en: But the mood suddenly shifted.
sentences.zh: 但气氛突然变了。

sentences.en: Colin told Graham that God had sent him.
sentences.zh: 科林告诉格雷厄姆是上帝派他来的。

sentences.en: Caught off guard by his comment, Graham laughed, which angered Colin.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆对他的评论感到措手不及，笑了笑，这激怒了科林。

sentences.en: He told Graham it was blasphemous to laugh at God and that Graham would pay for it.
sentences.zh: 他告诉格雷厄姆，嘲笑上帝是亵渎神明的，格雷厄姆会为此付出代价。

sentences.en: Colin's mood then quickly shifted again.
sentences.zh: 科林的脾气随后又迅速发生了变化。

sentences.en: He became quiet and calm, asking, why did you kill my son?
sentences.zh: 他变得安静而平静，问道，你为什么要杀我的儿子？

sentences.en: Graham told Colin that he didn't, reminding him that Digby had died in a car accident.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆告诉科林他没有，提醒他迪格比死于车祸。

sentences.en: It was then that Colin produced a Stanley knife and lunged at Graham, shouting that he was doing God's work.
sentences.zh: 就在那时，科林掏出一把史丹利刀向格雷厄姆扑去，大喊他在替天行道。

sentences.en: Colin slashed Graham across the face and cheSt. In shock and bleeding heavily,
sentences.zh: 科林割破了格雷厄姆的脸和胸部。在震惊和大量出血的情况下，

sentences.en: Graham managed to flee into the hallway.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆设法逃到走廊里。

sentences.en: He grabbed the 12-gate shotgun that had been leaning on the stairs and spun around to face his attacker.
sentences.zh: 他抓起靠在楼梯上的12门猎枪，转身面对袭击者。

sentences.en: Graham shouted for Colin to stop, warning that he would shoot.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆大喊让科林停下来，并警告说他会开枪。

sentences.en: But Colin kept moving forward, the Stanley knife raised.
sentences.zh: 但科林继续向前走，手里的史丹利刀举得高高的。

sentences.en: Graham had no choice.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆别无选择。

sentences.en: He fired two shots and Colin fell to the floor.
sentences.zh: 他开了两枪，科林倒在地板上。

sentences.en: Two days after the shooting, Graham Backhouse was discharged from hospital.
sentences.zh: 枪击事件发生两天后，格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯出院。

sentences.en: He spent a few days with his mother before being permitted to return to Whitton Hill.
sentences.zh: 他和母亲待了几天，然后才被允许返回惠顿希尔。

sentences.en: Later that week, his wife Margaret was also discharged.
sentences.zh: 那周晚些时候，他的妻子玛格丽特也出院了。

sentences.en: She had recovered from the bomb blast, but still required crutches to move around.
sentences.zh: 她从炸弹爆炸中恢复过来，但仍然需要拐杖四处走动。

sentences.en: Margaret travelled directly to her parents' home in the West Midlands to be reunited with her children.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特直接前往西米德兰兹郡父母的家，与孩子团聚。

sentences.en: With Colin Bedale-Taylor dead after being identified as the Backhouse's harasser, it seemed to be an open and shut case.
sentences.zh: 随着被确定为巴克豪斯骚扰者的科林·贝代尔-泰勒死亡，这似乎是一个明确的案件。

sentences.en: But investigators weren't so sure.
sentences.zh: 但调查人员并不那么确定。

sentences.en: When Graham Backhouse had been recovering from his injuries, police conducted a grid search of
sentences.zh: 当格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯从伤势中恢复时，警方对

sentences.en: Columberdale Taylor's property.
sentences.zh: 科伦伯代尔·泰勒的房产。

sentences.en: As one officer was scanning the front garden, a flash of metal in the grass caught his eye.
sentences.zh: 正当一名警官扫描前花园时，草地上一闪而过的金属引起了他的注意。

sentences.en: Upon closer inspection, the officer realised it was a piece of scaffolding pipe.
sentences.zh: 走近一看，警察意识到这是一段脚手架管。

sentences.en: It looked remarkably similar to the one used in the Backhouse's car bomb.
sentences.zh: 它看起来非常像巴克豪斯汽车炸弹中使用的那个。

sentences.en: The two pipes were examined under microscope.
sentences.zh: 在显微镜下检查了两根管道。

sentences.en: When compared, markings caused by a hacksaw on the end of each matched up.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，每个端部钢锯造成的标记相吻合。

sentences.en: This provided a direct link between Columberdale
sentences.zh: 这在科伦伯代尔之间建立了直接联系

sentences.en: Taylor and the bomb.
sentences.zh: 泰勒和炸弹。

sentences.en: But there was something about the pipe's location that didn't seem right.
sentences.zh: 但管道的位置有些不对劲。

sentences.en: The grass underneath it hadn't withered and it was barely flattened by the weight of the pipe.
sentences.zh: 它下面的草没有枯萎，几乎没有被管道的重量压平。

sentences.en: It appeared that the pipe had only been in the grass for a day or two.
sentences.zh: 看来管道在草地上只呆了一两天。

sentences.en: This raised the question, why would Colin relocate the pipe three weeks after the bomb?
sentences.zh: 这就提出了一个问题，为什么科林在炸弹爆炸三周后要搬迁管道？

sentences.en: And why leave it in a place where it could be so easily found?
sentences.zh: 为什么把它留在这么容易找到的地方？

sentences.en: Police began to consider the possibility that Colin Bedale-Taylor hadn't touched the pipe at all.
sentences.zh: 警方开始考虑科林·贝代尔-泰勒根本没有碰过这根管道的可能性。

sentences.en: He'd been framed.
sentences.zh: 他被陷害了。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案室马上回来。

sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Following the explosion that nearly killed Margaret Backhouse, one of the Whittenhill farmhands had told police he recalled hearing noises
sentences.zh: 在差点杀死玛格丽特·巴克豪斯的爆炸发生后，惠滕希尔的一名农场工人告诉警方，他记得听到噪音

sentences.en: coming from an outbuilding a few days before the bomb went off.
sentences.zh: 炸弹爆炸前几天从一处附属建筑传来。

sentences.en: At the time, the farmhand thought he was the only person on the premises.
sentences.zh: 当时，农场工人以为自己是场地上唯一的人。

sentences.en: He went to investigate the noise, only to find Graham Backhouse cutting a length of pipe with a hacksaw.
sentences.zh: 他去调查噪音，却发现格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯正用钢锯切割一段管道。

sentences.en: Schoolgirl Susan Wilkie had been one of the first on the scene after the car bomb went off.
sentences.zh: 汽车炸弹爆炸后，女学生苏珊·威尔基是第一批赶到现场的人之一。

sentences.en: Susan told detectives that when she ran to tell Graham that Margaret had been injured, she never mentioned anything about a bomb or an explosion.
sentences.zh: 苏珊告诉侦探，当她跑去告诉格雷厄姆玛格丽特受伤时，她从未提过关于炸弹或爆炸的任何事情。

sentences.en: Graham couldn't have heard the explosion from the milking shed and he didn't enter the barn at the time.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆不可能从挤奶棚听到爆炸声，而且当时他也没有进入谷仓。

sentences.en: Yet, when he phoned for the ambulance, he specifically told the operator that his wife had been injured in an explosion.
sentences.zh: 然而，当他打电话叫救护车时，他明确告诉接线员他的妻子在爆炸中受伤了。

sentences.en: The person who installed the car bomb had to be familiar with the particular model of
sentences.zh: 安放汽车炸弹的人必须熟悉该特定型号的

sentences.en: Volvo.
sentences.zh: 沃尔沃。

sentences.en: They would have also needed extended access to the vehicle in order to fit the device.
sentences.zh: 为了安装设备，他们还需要长期使用该车。

sentences.en: Graham Backhouse ticked both of these boxes.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯勾选了这两个方框。

sentences.en: Throughout their investigations, detectives had remained open to the possibility that Graham was involved in the attack.
sentences.zh: 在整个调查过程中，侦探们一直对格雷厄姆参与袭击的可能性持开放态度。

sentences.en: But there was no physical evidence linking him to the crime, and by all accounts, Graham and Margaret had a happy and loving relationship.
sentences.zh: 但没有物证将他与这起犯罪联系起来，而且据各方报道，格雷厄姆和玛格丽特有着幸福美满的恋爱关系。

sentences.en: It seemed much more likely that someone else was responsible, and as such, they directed their inquiries elsewhere.
sentences.zh: 似乎更有可能是别人负责，因此，他们将调查转向了别处。

sentences.en: After Colin Bedale-Taylor's death, several more questions were raised.
sentences.zh: 科林·贝代尔-泰勒死后，又提出了几个问题。

sentences.en: Graham told officers that Colin had slashed him with a Stanley knife while the two were in the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆告诉警察，两人在厨房时，科林用一把史丹利刀割伤了他。

sentences.en: But when forensic investigators analysed the crime scene, they found no cast-off blood spatter on the walls, floor, or furniture as would be expected.
sentences.zh: 但是当法医调查人员分析犯罪现场时，他们没有在墙壁、地板或家具上发现预期的飞溅血迹。

sentences.en: Instead, round drops of blood were grouped together in several locations on the kitchen floor.
sentences.zh: 相反，一滴滴圆形的血滴聚集在厨房地板上的几个地方。

sentences.en: Some of the blood drops were found underneath the upturned kitchen chairs, while smears of blood were also found on the backrest of each chair.
sentences.zh: 有些血滴是在翻倒的厨房椅子下面发现的，而在每张椅子的靠背上也发现了血迹。

sentences.en: After being injured, Graham claimed to have fled the kitchen and stumbled into the hallway to grab his shotgun.
sentences.zh: 受伤后，格雷厄姆声称逃离厨房，跌跌撞撞地走进走廊去拿他的猎枪。

sentences.en: However, there was no trail of blood leading between these two locations, and not a drop of blood on the shotgun.
sentences.zh: 然而，这两个地方之间没有血迹，猎枪上也没有一滴血。

sentences.en: Droplets of blood matching Graham's blood type were also found on Colin's body.
sentences.zh: 在科林的尸体上也发现了与格雷厄姆血型相匹配的血滴。

sentences.en: With the blood evidence raising more questions than answers, investigators turned to the threatening letters that Graham Backhouse had received.
sentences.zh: 随着血迹证据引发的问题多于答案，调查人员将目光转向了格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯收到的威胁信。

sentences.en: A handwriting expert compared the notes to a sample of Colin Bedale-Taylor's handwriting.
sentences.zh: 笔迹专家将这些便条与科林·贝代尔-泰勒的笔迹样本进行了比较。

sentences.en: The lettering was completely different.
sentences.zh: 字母完全不同。

sentences.en: The notes were then compared to the handwriting of Graham Backhouse.
sentences.zh: 然后将这些便条与格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯的笔迹进行了比较。

sentences.en: This time, the similarities were significant.
sentences.zh: 这一次，相似之处非常明显。

sentences.en: On the death thread accompanying the sheep's head, the words, you next, had been scrawled on a piece of lined notebook paper.
sentences.zh: 在夹着羊头的死亡威胁信上，写着“下一个就是你”，字迹是用带格子的笔记本纸草草写成的。

sentences.en: Some of the sheep's blood had seeped into the paper, but analysts were still able to make out an imprint on the back of the page.
sentences.zh: 部分羊血渗入了纸张，但分析人员仍然能够辨认出页面背面的压痕。

sentences.en: It was a complex, spiral-shaped doodle.
sentences.zh: 那是一个复杂的、螺旋形的涂鸦。

sentences.en: When police were collecting evidence from the Whittenhill farmhouse after Colin was shot, they seized a small lined notebook from Graham's study.
sentences.zh: 当警察在科林被枪杀后从惠滕希尔农舍收集证据时，他们从格雷厄姆的书房里查获了一个带格子的笔记本。

sentences.en: The paper was of a similar size to the U-Next note.
sentences.zh: 纸张的大小与“下一个就是你”的便条相似。

sentences.en: Investigators flicked through the pages until something caught their eye.
sentences.zh: 调查人员翻阅着纸页，直到有什么东西吸引了他们的目光。

sentences.en: Drawn in pen was the exact same spiral-shaped doodle.
sentences.zh: 笔画出的正是完全相同的螺旋形涂鸦。

sentences.en: With this evidence emerging, investigators grew confident that Graham Backhouse had planted the bomb with the intention of killing his wife.
sentences.zh: 随着这一证据的出现，调查人员越发确信格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯安放炸弹的意图是杀死他的妻子。

sentences.en: Failing to do so, he framed Colin Bedale Taylor for the crime.
sentences.zh: 在未能得逞后，他将这起罪行栽赃给科林·贝代尔·泰勒。

sentences.en: The question was, why?
sentences.zh: 问题是，为什么？

sentences.en: Graham's financial records revealed that he had inherited
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆的财务记录显示，他在1979年从父亲比尔那里继承了

sentences.en: Whittenhill Farm from his father, Bill, in 1979.
sentences.zh: 惠滕希尔农场。

sentences.en: At the time, the farm was a profitable business, renowned for producing champion dairy cows.
sentences.zh: 当时，这个农场是一项盈利的生意，以出产冠军奶牛而闻名。

sentences.en: In an attempt to increase the farm's revenue,
sentences.zh: 为了增加农场的收入，

sentences.en: Graham tried his hand at growing cereal crops on some of the excess land.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆尝试在一些多余的土地上种植谷物。

sentences.en: But the crops were quickly ravaged by the plant disease known as take-all, and the venture failed.
sentences.zh: 但庄稼很快就被被称为全蚀病的植物病害毁了，这次尝试以失败告终。

sentences.en: Unlike his father, Graham was not an astute businessman.
sentences.zh: 与他的父亲不同，格雷厄姆不是一个精明的商人。

sentences.en: Over the next four years, he mismanaged the dairy farm and it began to lose money.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的四年里，他经营不善，奶牛场开始亏损。

sentences.en: By the end of 1983, the farm was £70,000 in debt.
sentences.zh: 到1983年底，农场已经负债7万英镑。

sentences.en: Graham had run it into the ground.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆把它搞垮了。

sentences.en: A search of the Backhouser's personal records revealed that Graham and Margaret had recently applied to double the payout on their life insurance policies.
sentences.zh: 对巴克豪斯夫妇个人记录的搜查显示，格雷厄姆和玛格丽特最近曾申请将他们的人寿保险赔付额翻倍。

sentences.en: In the event of Margaret's death, Graham stood to receive £100,000.
sentences.zh: 如果玛格丽特身亡，格雷厄姆将获得10万英镑。

sentences.en: Only days after the application was made, the so-called Campaign of Threats against Graham began.
sentences.zh: 就在申请提交几天后，针对格雷厄姆的所谓威胁运动开始了。

sentences.en: On Thursday April 5 1984, the new life insurance policies were approved.
sentences.zh: 1984年4月5日星期四，新的人寿保险保单获批。

sentences.en: Four days later, Margaret unwittingly detonated the car bomb.
sentences.zh: 四天后，玛格丽特在不知情的情况下引爆了汽车炸弹。

sentences.en: Having failed in his plot to kill his wife, investigators believed that Graham Backhouse
sentences.zh: 谋杀妻子的阴谋失败后，调查人员认为格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯

sentences.en: was faced with two probleMs. The first was that he still needed to pay off his crippling debt.
sentences.zh: 面临着两个问题。第一个是他仍然需要还清那笔沉重的债务。

sentences.en: Inquiries with his insurance company revealed that in the week after the explosion,
sentences.zh: 向他的保险公司进行查询后发现，在爆炸发生后的那一周，

sentences.en: Graham submitted a claim on Margaret's behalf.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆代表玛格丽特提交了一份索赔申请。

sentences.en: Given that she'd survived, they weren't entitled to the full 100,000 pounds, but Margaret's serious injuries would have warranted at least some amount of compensation.
sentences.zh: 鉴于她幸存了下来，他们无权获得全部10万英镑，但玛格丽特的严重受伤本应理应获得至少一定金额的赔偿。

sentences.en: Graham's second, larger problem was that he needed to deflect suspicion away from himself.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆的第二个、更大的问题是，他需要转移人们对他的怀疑。

sentences.en: In addition to coming clean about his legitimate infidelities, he fabricated an affair with Gillian Lippiat.
sentences.zh: 除了坦白他名正言顺的不忠行为外，他还捏造了与吉莉安·利皮亚特的婚外情。

sentences.en: He also concocted a boundary dispute with Colin
sentences.zh: 他还捏造了与科林的边界纠纷

sentences.en: Bedale Taylor.
sentences.zh: 贝代尔·泰勒。

sentences.en: These admissions opened up several lines of investigation, all painting Graham as a target for someone's grievance.
sentences.zh: 这些供述引发了几个调查方向，所有这些都把格雷厄姆描绘成某人怨恨的目标。

sentences.en: Police believed that Graham's plan was to frame someone else and then kill that person himself, citing self-defence.
sentences.zh: 警方认为，格雷厄姆的计划是陷害别人，然后自己亲手杀掉那个人，并以正当防卫为由脱罪。

sentences.en: In preparation, he dismissed the
sentences.zh: 在筹备过程中，他解散了

sentences.en: 24-hour police guard.
sentences.zh: 24小时警察警卫。

sentences.en: For the next stage of his plan, Graham needed to lure one of the possible targets to the farmhouse.
sentences.zh: 为了计划的下一阶段，格雷厄姆需要将其中一个潜在目标引诱到农舍。

sentences.en: By Monday April 30, Graham had settled on Colin Bedale-Taylor.
sentences.zh: 到4月30日星期一，格雷厄姆选定了科林·贝代尔·泰勒。

sentences.en: That afternoon, Graham invited Colin over to Whitten Hill, likely under the pretense of doing some furniture restoration work.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，格雷厄姆邀请科林来到惠滕希尔，很可能是以做一些家具修复工作的借口。

sentences.en: Police were called to the farm within 10 minutes of Colin leaving his home.
sentences.zh: 在科林离开家后不到10分钟，警察就被叫到了农场。

sentences.en: Investigators therefore concluded that Graham had opened fire on Colin almost immediately after he set foot inside.
sentences.zh: 因此，调查人员得出结论，格雷厄姆在科林刚踏进门时几乎立刻就开枪了。

sentences.en: Colin was shot twice in the cheSt. Forensics revealed that the second shot had been fired as Colin was falling backwards or lying flat on the floor,
sentences.zh: 科林胸部中了两枪。法医透露，第二枪是在科林向后倒下或平躺在地上时开的，

sentences.en: disputing Graham's claim of self-defence.
sentences.zh: 这反驳了格雷厄姆关于正当防卫的说法。

sentences.en: Graham then set about staging the crime scene and making it look like he'd been attacked.
sentences.zh: 接着，格雷厄姆着手布置犯罪现场，使其看起来像是他遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: The wounds to Graham's face and body were continuous slices, indicating that he was standing very still when the injuries occurred.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆脸部和身体上的伤口是连续的划痕，这表明受伤时他站得非常笔直。

sentences.en: No defensive cuts were found on his hands or arMs. A forensic expert concluded that Graham's injuries were self-inflicted.
sentences.zh: 在他的手或手臂上没有发现防御性的割伤。一位法医专家得出结论，格雷厄姆的伤是他自己造成的。

sentences.en: After slashing his own face and torso, police believed that
sentences.zh: 警方认为，在割伤自己的脸和躯干后，

sentences.en: Graham leant over Colin's body and placed the Stanley knife in his right hand.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆俯身在科林的尸体上，将一把史丹利美工刀放在他的右手里。

sentences.en: This explained why drops of Graham's blood were found on Colin's body.
sentences.zh: 这就解释了为什么在科林的尸体上发现了格雷厄姆的血滴。

sentences.en: It also explained why Colin was still holding the knife.
sentences.zh: 这也解释了为什么科林还握着刀。

sentences.en: Had he really been wielding the knife at Graham, investigators believed Colin would have dropped it after being shot.
sentences.zh: 如果他真的拿着刀向格雷厄姆挥舞，调查人员认为科林中枪后会把刀扔掉。

sentences.en: The round drops of blood on the kitchen floor and the contact blood on the backrest of the chairs indicated that Graham then walked around the room,
sentences.zh: 厨房地板上的圆形血滴和椅子靠背上的接触血迹表明，格雷厄姆随后在房间里走动，

sentences.en: upturning the chairs to make it look like a struggle had taken place.
sentences.zh: 翻倒椅子，使之看起来发生过搏斗。

sentences.en: Only when Graham was satisfied with the scene did he hit the panic button and wait for the police
sentences.zh: 只有当格雷厄姆对现场满意时，他才按下了紧急呼叫按钮并等待警察。

sentences.en: Twelve days after the shooting and almost five weeks after the car bomb
sentences.zh: 枪击事件发生十二天后，汽车炸弹事件将近五周后，

sentences.en: Graham Backhouse joined his family in the Midlands for the day When he returned home to Whidden Hill that evening, detectives paid him a visit
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯前往米德兰兹与家人共度了一天。当他那天晚上回到惠登希尔时，侦探们来拜访了他。

sentences.en: Graham Backhouse was arrested and charged with the murder of Columberdale Taylor and the attempted murder of Margaret Backhouse
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯被捕，并被指控谋杀科伦·贝代尔·泰勒以及企图谋杀玛格丽特·巴克豪斯。

sentences.en: He was held in remand, awaiting trial.
sentences.zh: 他被还押候审，等待审判。

sentences.en: Shortly after, prison guards confiscated a letter addressed to local newspaper the Bristol Evening Post as it was being smuggled out of the prison.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，狱警截获了一封寄给当地报纸《布里斯托尔晚报》的信，当时这封信正被偷运出监狱。

sentences.en: Penned by an anonymous writer, the letter read in part,
sentences.zh: 这封由匿名作者撰写的信部分内容如下：

sentences.en: Them three letters in the backhouse bomb case, I wrote them.
sentences.zh: 巴克豪斯炸弹案中的那三封信，是我写的。

sentences.en: Colin Bedale-Taylor made me.
sentences.zh: 科林·贝代尔·泰勒逼我的。

sentences.en: He said it was God's work because Backhouse was a wicked man.
sentences.zh: 他说这是上帝的工作，因为巴克豪斯是个邪恶的人。

sentences.en: Colin never said anything about any bomb until afterwards.
sentences.zh: 科林事后才提起任何关于炸弹的事。

sentences.en: I would not have done it if he had said.
sentences.zh: 如果他早说的话，我是不会干的。

sentences.en: I told Colin that God would punish him, and now he is dead.
sentences.zh: 我告诉过科林上帝会惩罚他，现在他死了。

sentences.en: God has forgiven me.
sentences.zh: 上帝已经原谅了我。

sentences.en: I don't trust pigs.
sentences.zh: 我不相信这帮猪。

sentences.en: That is why I write to you.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我写信给你。

sentences.en: Please help.
sentences.zh: 请帮帮我。

sentences.en: Police knew immediately who wrote the letter.
sentences.zh: 警方立刻认出是谁写了这封信。

sentences.en: A few days earlier, Graham Backhouse had written to his wife Margaret, claiming that the police had framed him.
sentences.zh: 几天前，格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯曾写信给他的妻子玛格丽特，声称警方陷害了他。

sentences.en: He was desperate to, quote, get out of this hellhole.
sentences.zh: 他迫切地想要“逃离这个人间地狱”。

sentences.en: Graham revealed his plan to write an anonymous letter to a newspaper to make people believe that someone else was responsible for the bomb.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆透露了他的计划：给一家报纸写一封匿名信，让人以为炸弹是别人干的。

sentences.en: Graham boasted that he could write the letter well enough to throw the police case into confusion.
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆吹嘘说，他能把信写得足够好，从而把警方的案子搅得一团糟。

sentences.en: He just needed Margaret to send him more writing materials.
sentences.zh: 他只需要玛格丽特给他寄更多的书写材料。

sentences.en: Graham concluded,
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆总结道：

sentences.en: I know it is wrong of me to ask you to do this, but I am innocent.
sentences.zh: 我知道要求你这么做是不对的，但我确实是无辜的。

sentences.en: I have no one else to turn to.
sentences.zh: 我没有其他人可以求助了。

sentences.en: You are my only hope.
sentences.zh: 你是我唯一的希望。

sentences.en: I love you.
sentences.zh: 我爱你。

sentences.en: Margaret didn't follow through on Graham's requeSt.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特没有顺从格雷厄姆的要求。

sentences.en: Instead, she handed the letter to the police.
sentences.zh: 相反，她把信交给了警方。

sentences.en: The handwriting on the Bristol Evening Post letter was analysed by an expert, leaving no doubt that it had been written by Graham Backhouse
sentences.zh: 经专家分析，《布里斯托尔晚报》信件上的笔迹，毫无疑问是由格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯书写的。

sentences.en: Graham's trial commenced in January 1985
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆的审判于1985年1月开始。

sentences.en: He pleaded not guilty to both charges and testified to his innocence on the stand
sentences.zh: 他对两项指控均不认罪，并在证人席上坚称自己无罪。

sentences.en: The prosecutor told the court that Graham Backhouse intended to kill his wife Margaret in order to pay his debts with her life insurance money
sentences.zh: 检察官在法庭上表示，格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯意图杀死妻子玛格丽特，以便用她的保险金来偿还债务。

sentences.en: He said that Graham's crimes were carefully planned, quite deliberate, and carried out in cold blood
sentences.zh: 他说，格雷厄姆的罪行是经过精心策划、蓄意为之且冷血实施的。

sentences.en: Margaret Backhouse sobbed quietly in the public gallery each day as the evidence against her husband was laid out
sentences.zh: 每天在陈述针对她丈夫的证据时，玛格丽特·巴克豪斯都在旁听席上默默啜泣。

sentences.en: Graham denied this version of events He maintained his story about being ambushed by Columba Dale Taylor, saying he'd feared for his life during the attack
sentences.zh: 格雷厄姆否认了这一版本的事件经过。他坚持自己遭到科伦·贝代尔·泰勒伏击的说法，称自己在袭击中曾担心自己的生命安全。

sentences.en: In his closing statement, the prosecutor told the jury that they simply needed to decide who was the villain in the case.
sentences.zh: 在结案陈词中，检察官告诉陪审团，他们只需要判定谁才是本案中的恶人。

sentences.en: Was it Colin Bedale-Taylor or Graham Backhouse?
sentences.zh: 是科林·贝代尔·泰勒还是格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯？

sentences.en: When the jury was unable to reach a unanimous decision, the judge permitted a majority verdict.
sentences.zh: 当陪审团无法达成一致裁决时，法官允许作出多数裁决。

sentences.en: Ninety minutes later, with a majority of 10-2, the jury found Graham Backhouse guilty on both counts.
sentences.zh: 九十分钟后，以10比2的多数票，陪审团裁定格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯两项罪名成立。

sentences.en: Graham began shaking in the dock as he was given two life sentences
sentences.zh: 当被判处两项终身监禁时，格雷厄姆在被告席上开始发抖。

sentences.en: The judge concluded
sentences.zh: 法官总结道：

sentences.en: You are a devious and wicked man
sentences.zh: 你是一个狡猾而邪恶的人。

sentences.en: The enormity of the crime that you have committed is very grave
sentences.zh: 你所犯下的罪行极其严重。

sentences.en: Not content with trying to kill a wife who, according to your own evidence, loved you and had done you no wrong
sentences.zh: 你不仅企图杀死一个根据你自己的证词深爱着你且从未做过对不起你的妻子的女人，

sentences.en: You then set about cold-bloodedly to plot and kill your neighbour who had never done you any harm and whom you barely knew
sentences.zh: 你随后又冷血地策划并杀害了你的邻居，他从未对你做过任何伤害，而你对他也知之甚少。

sentences.en: Outside court, Horton locals spoke of their relief at the verdict
sentences.zh: 在法庭外，霍顿当地人谈到这一判决时表达了他们的释怀。

sentences.en: One woman told reporters
sentences.zh: 一位女士告诉记者：

sentences.en: There has been a cloud hanging over us since the car bomb But now we hope the village can get back to normal
sentences.zh: 自从汽车炸弹事件以来，一片阴云一直笼罩着我们，但现在我们希望村子能恢复正常。

sentences.en: Jillian Lippiat, the woman Graham claimed to be having an ongoing affair with, said
sentences.zh: 吉莉安·利皮亚特，也就是格雷厄姆声称与其保持长期婚外情的女性，说道：

sentences.en: Backhouse goes down as another liar.
sentences.zh: 巴克豪斯落得个又一个骗子的下场。

sentences.en: He has not said one word of truth in court.
sentences.zh: 他在法庭上没有说一句实话。

sentences.en: Margaret Backhouse requested privacy for herself and her family.
sentences.zh: 玛格丽特·巴克豪斯请求为她和家人保留隐私。

sentences.en: Despite the trauma that the farmhouse represented, Margaret and her children continued to live at Whittenhill until it was sold six months later.
sentences.zh: 尽管农舍代表着精神创伤，但玛格丽特和她的孩子们依然住在惠滕希尔，直到六个月后它被售出。

sentences.en: The property eventually became a horseboarding stable and a riding estate.
sentences.zh: 这处房产最终变成了一个寄宿马厩和骑马庄园。

sentences.en: Supported by the community, Margaret remained close to Horton.
sentences.zh: 在社区的支持下，玛格丽特留在了霍顿附近。

sentences.en: The following year, her divorce from Graham was finalised, with the court readily agreeing with the grounds of unreasonable behaviour.
sentences.zh: 第二年，她与格雷厄姆的离婚手续正式办结，法庭毫不犹豫地同意了以对方行为不合理为由的离婚申请。

sentences.en: In 1994, less than 10 years into his sentence, Graham Backhouse was playing cricket in the prison exercise yard when he suffered a heart attack.
sentences.zh: 1994年，在服刑不到10年后，格雷厄姆·巴克豪斯在监狱操场打板球时突发心脏病。

sentences.en: He died three days later.
sentences.zh: 三天后他去世了。

sentences.en: The following year, 48-year-old Margaret Backhouse passed away from cancer.
sentences.zh: 第二年，48岁的玛格丽特·巴克豪斯因癌症离世。

sentences.en: She was survived by her two teenage children.
sentences.zh: 她留下了两个正处于青春期的孩子。

sentences.en: Colin Bedale-Taylor had been a man of the people.
sentences.zh: 科林·贝代尔·泰勒曾是一个接地气的人。

sentences.en: In addition to his furniture restoration work, he had served as a chairman on the Village Hall Committee and had helped draw plans to rebuild the community hall.
sentences.zh: 除了家具修复工作外，他还担任过村议会大厅委员会的主席，并协助绘制了重建社区大厅的图纸。

sentences.en: Just the day before he was killed, Colin had agreed to become a sidesman at the village church, a role that would entail handing out hymn books and showing people to their seats.
sentences.zh: 就在他遇害的前一天，科林刚刚同意担任乡村教堂的助理司事，这项工作包括分发赞颂诗集和引导人们入座。

sentences.en: That same day, he had erected a handmade wooden sign outside the local school, which was facing budget cuts, so that its name could be proudly displayed.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天，他在面临预算削减的当地学校外面竖起了一个手工制作的木制招牌，以便能够自豪地展示学校的名字。

sentences.en: The church rector described Colin as a quiet man who was full of fun.
sentences.zh: 教堂牧师形容科林是一个安静且充满乐趣的人。

sentences.en: In the wake of Graham's conviction, he expressed relief that Colin's name had been completely cleared
sentences.zh: 在格雷厄姆被定罪后，他表达了欣慰，认为科林的名誉已经完全洗清。

sentences.en: Another villager told the Western Daily Press
sentences.zh: 另一位村民告诉《西方每日新闻》：

sentences.en: Colin was a good friend to a lot of people and had done many kindnesses He will be tremendously missed by the whole village
sentences.zh: 科林是许多人的好朋友，做过许多善事。整个村庄都会无比怀念他。

sentences.en: Six weeks after Colin's murder, nearly every resident of Horton crammed into the small village church to attend his funeral
sentences.zh: 在科林遇害六周后，霍顿几乎所有的居民都挤进了小村教堂参加他的葬礼。

sentences.en: Referring to the large number of attendees, one local said
sentences.zh: 谈到大量的出席人数，一位当地人说道：

sentences.en: The people of Horton will say with their feet what they cannot say with their mouths about the death of Colin
sentences.zh: 霍顿的人民将用他们的双脚，来表达他们无法用言语诉说的对科林离世的哀悼。

sentences.en: Colin was laid to rest next to his beloved son, Digby
sentences.zh: 科林长眠在他挚爱的儿子迪格比身边。

sentences.en: In the weeks that followed, plans were made to erect a plaque in Colin's honour
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几周里，人们计划为科林竖立一块牌匾以示纪念。

sentences.en: A community spokesperson told the Bristol Evening Post
sentences.zh: 一位社区发言人告诉《布里斯托尔晚报》：

sentences.en: We don't want to remember him as a murdered man, but as someone who has done a lot of work in the village for years.
sentences.zh: 我们不想把他当成一个被谋杀的人来怀念，而是要把他当作一个多年来在村里做过大量工作的人来铭记。
